# Hand-written triggers (NOT regenerated by scripts/advance_parser.py).

# rl_enabled = { s = <setting_id> }
#
# True when one of our Community Mod Menu settings is enabled. Every setting
# defaults to ON, so this deliberately FAILS OPEN: if registration has not run
# yet, the feature is treated as enabled.
#
# Why: CMF fires cmf_on_mod_registration from its yearly human-country pulse.
# Until that pulse runs, "global_variable_map(cmm|flag:...)" reads 0 with no
# error, so gating strictly on ">= 1" silently disabled the mod -- e.g. right
# after loading a save, or during the first year of a new game.
rl_enabled = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { has_global_variable = rl_settings_ready }
        "global_variable_map(cmm|flag:europa_survivors__$s$)" >= 1
    }
}
